Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. About the program
Binance Accelerator Program is a concise fixed-term program designed for Early Career Talent to have an immersive experience in the rapidly expanding Web3 space. You will be given the opportunity to experience life at Binance and understand what goes on behind the scenes of the worlds’ leading blockchain ecosystem. Alongside your job, there will also be a focus on networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about BAP Program HERE
 
Who may apply
Current university students and recent graduates
 
About the team
The Binance Wallet team is building a decentralized version of Binance, featuring on-chain infrastructure, self-custody wallets, a DEX, decentralized Earn, and more. We empower users with full control over their assets for seamless token trading across any blockchain. This Web3 initiative expands our strategic landscape and complements our CEX business, offering significant growth potential. Join us and be part of this exciting journey.

lists.content: We are building cutting-edge AI systems that enable the next generation of intelligent applications. Our team focuses on developing AI agents, benchmarking datasets, and robust infrastructure to support real-world deployments at scale. As part of our engineering-driven culture, you'll be exposed to a fast-paced environment where experimentation, collaboration, and innovation are encouraged.

- Contribute to the design and development of AI agents integrated into live production systems
- Help build and maintain benchmark datasets to evaluate agent performance, accuracy, and safety
- Design and refine prompts, tool integrations, and agent workflows
- Implement, test, and optimize services and tooling across the stack — backend, data, scripting, automation, and glue code
- Collaborate closely with senior engineers on system design, multi-agent orchestration, and deployment
- Participate in code reviews, debugging, and documentation to ensure best practices
- Work in a team environment that encourages mentorship, knowledge sharing, and hands-on learning

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Strong programming fundamentals — language-agnostic, but practical experience with at least one of Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar
- Solid understanding of software engineering principles (data structures, algorithms, version control)
- Familiarity or working knowledge of any AI agent framework (e.g., OpenClaw, hermes-agent, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen)
- Interest in AI, data-driven systems, and building tools for real-world applications
- Good communication skills and willingness to learn quickly

- AI-native working style — you naturally reach for AI tools in your daily workflow, not as an afterthought but as a core part of how you think, build, and solve problems
- Eager to learn and open-minded — you stay current with the latest technologies and aren't afraid to adopt new frameworks, tools, or paradigms before they're mainstream
- First-principles thinker who's comfortable redesigning workflows rather than just optimizing existing ones

- Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or building tools on top of AI models
- Exposure to multi-agent systems or agent orchestration patterns
- Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines
- Machine learning knowledge is a plus, but not required

lists.content:
• Research practical, AI-powered ways to deliver on our learning goals, and recommend what's worth implementing.

  • Build and launch new learning initiatives, from first idea to something people use.

  • Run and improve async onboarding, so new joiners get a smooth, mostly automated experience.

  • Organize and maintain our learning knowledge, so it's easy to find, trust and keep up to date.

  • Work with stakeholders across the company to understand their learning needs and turn them into practical solutions.

• Strong experience organizing and managing knowledge: structuring information, keeping it current, and making it easy to use.

  • A systems mindset: you see how the pieces connect, and you follow through until it works.

  • Comfort solving problems from ambiguity, turning an idea or a rough goal into a clear plan.

  • A people-first approach: you think about the learner and their experience, not just the tool.

  • Experience in learning and development, HR, enablement, or a related field is a plus, though it's not the centre of the role.

  • Ability to create clear, simple learning content and communications.

lists.content:
• Design across branding, campaigns, and digital platforms: logos, visual identity systems, social and display content, presentations, web and landing pages, and more.
  • Use generative AI tools & models (e.g. Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc.) throughout your process: concepting, ideation, image generation, layout exploration, and production to move faster without sacrificing craft.
  • Translate creative briefs into polished, on-brand visual concepts, iterating based on feedback from creative leads and clients.
  • Maintain and evolve visual identity systems, ensuring consistency across deliverables and touchpoints.
  • Apply strong fundamentals such as typography, layout, color, and composition to produce work that is both conceptually sharp and production-ready.

  • Collaborate closely with Creative Leads, Project Managers, and fellow designers across multiple concurrent projects and accounts.

  • Manage your time and priorities across multiple projects, meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality.

• 4+ years of experience as a designer, with a portfolio that demonstrates strong conceptual thinking and visual craft across brand, campaign, and digital work.
  • Hands-on, current experience with generative AI creative tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, Seedance, etc as a required, everyday part of your workflow, not a nice-to-have.
  • Deep proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma.
  • Solid grounding in design fundamentals: typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to interpret briefs and explain design decisions clearly.
  • A collaborative mindset, comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and working across distributed, cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Self-motivation and comfort working independently in a remote-first environment.

job_detail_fetch.description:

This is a foundational role for someone who wants a front-row seat to how a fast-growing, AI-powered creative company operates at the top. You keep two senior leaders moving fast, while the Chief of Staff owns the strategy, agenda, and outcomes behind the work.

lists.content:
• Own scheduling for the CEO's and Chief of Staff's calendars — key meetings, 1:1s, department meetings, All Hands — across a fast-moving, frequently reorganizing org.
  • Manage day-to-day correspondence and calendar logistics for both leaders.
  • Operations Projects & Process Support: Partner directly with the Chief of Staff on core operational projects, cross-functional initiatives, workflow tracking, and process improvements across the company.
  • Build and format decks and support CoS in running leadership meetings, MBRs, board updates, and strategy sessions (production and formatting — the Chief of Staff owns agenda and content).
  • Coordinate offsite and customer summit logistics: travel, venues, vendor coordination (the Chief of Staff owns agenda and outcomes).
  • Act as a first point of contact for scheduling requests from senior stakeholders, using judgment on what needs the Chief of Staff's or CEO's direct attention versus what you can resolve yourself.
  • Handle sensitive information with discretion — compensation conversations, reorg planning, and personnel matters naturally surface in a CEO-adjacent role.
  • Track recurring commitments and deadlines for the CEO and Chief of Staff, flagging conflicts before they become problems.
  • Support with light research, note-taking, time-keeping, and follow-up tracking during leadership meetings.
  • Partner with the Chief of Staff on ad hoc projects tied to leadership initiatives.
  • Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to speed up drafting, summarizing, and day-to-day admin work.

• Experience: Background as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, or Ops Specialist supporting senior executives in a fast-growing startup, agency, or tech/SaaS environment.
  • A track record of exercising judgment: knowing when to make a call versus when to escalate, not just executing a task list.
  • Demonstrated discretion handling sensitive or confidential information.
  • Strong organizational, proactiveness and prioritisation skills to organize your day-to-day and tackle challenges as they come in the right order
  • Excellent written communication, including comfort drafting in someone else's voice.
  • Comfortable working async across time zones in a remote-first, global team.
  • Tech-fluent: Slack, Notion, Google Workspace.
  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for drafting or summarizing.
